_doc.what: Hatcher adapters — the per-AI shape of the birth rite (SPEC §12). Each entry says how to put the cypher to one LLM and how its answer comes back. The zoo never guesses a provider's shape; it reads it here.
_doc.fields: command (required), shape (cli|http|sdk), model, timeout (s), default (bool), discovered (bool — this adapter was learned on this device, not shipped)
_doc.discovery: An unknown AI that can break the cypher IS a species: `rappidex discover <name> --command '<how to call it>'` runs the rite, records the answering shape, and adds the species to the dex — then you hatch your own of it.
